title: Compact launch canvas and sprint logbook — Jul 2026 (wip)
body:
Purpose:
- One-page canvas for the upcoming sprint release (Jul week 2). Lightweight logbook to capture minute-level ops decisions and tentative rollback triggers.
- Keep it intentionally compact: use for on-shift screen, not full runbook.

Scope / what this deploy touches:
- Hosted API: model routing policy change (route-v2), small optimization to batching windowing and new canary model variant (openmodel-alpha-2026).
- Console: rollout toggle + per-route usage heatmap enabled.
- No infra migrations in this release.

Quick timeline (UTC):
- 2026-07-08 09:00 — Preflight 1 (sprint readiness, config bake)
- 2026-07-08 11:00 — Dry-run cutover in staging (30m)
- 2026-07-09 02:00 — Final preflight checklist sign-off window (engineers on-call overlap)
- 2026-07-09 04:00 — Production micro-canary (5% traffic, 30m)
- 2026-07-09 04:40 — Ramp to 25% (monitor 45m)
- 2026-07-09 06:00 — Gradual ramp to 100% (stair-step: 50%, 75%, 100%)
- 2026-07-09 08:30 — Post-cutover smoke & telemetry sanity check (2h observation)

Weekmatrix (high-level rollout calendar):
- Mon 2026-07-05: freeze non-critical merges + branch gating (all teams)
- Tue 2026-07-06: final QA signoffs, doc updates, release notes draft ready
- Wed 2026-07-07: staging rehearsals, validate scripts
- Thu 2026-07-08: preflight + dry-run (see timeline above)
- Fri 2026-07-09: production rollout window (low traffic window)
- Sat-Sun 2026-07-10-11: on-call observation, scheduled light traffic tests if system stable

Preflight checklist (compact):
- [ ] All PRs merged to release branch (check GH PR list) (owner: Marcus)
- [ ] JIRA release ticket updated with final commit hashes (JIRA-RELEASE-913) (owner: Evelyn)
- [ ] Config flags prepared and validated in staging (route-v2 toggle) (owner: Aisha)
- [ ] Canary model image built and stored (openmodel-alpha-2026) (owner: ML infra)
- [ ] Rollback image / recipe available and smoke-tested (scripts/rollback/revert-route-v2.sh)
- [ ] PagerDuty rotation set for release window; primary + secondary assigned (pd-release rotation)
- [ ] Slack channel created: #release-jul-09 (ops comms)
- [ ] Alert thresholds prepopulated in ops dashboard (latency P50/P95, error-rate)
- [ ] Telemetry smoke tests scripted and dry-run passed (telemetry/test-suite v3)

Cutover micro-steps (short form for on-console use):
1) Flip route-v2 toggle to canary mode (5%): admin-console > feature-flags > route-v2 -> canary-5
2) Monitor: latency P50, P95, API errors, model inference errors, CPU/GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate.
3) If stable (see rollback triggers), increment to 25% then 50% then 75% then 100% with 30–45m observation windows.
4) At each step run smoke tests: generate sample prompts from prompt-set/production-smoke.txt and validate output hashes + SLO latencies.

Rollback triggers (explicit):
- API error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m AND client-facing errors increasing (owner decision)
- P95 latency > 1500ms for 10m AND backend GPU saturation above 85%
- Model output regression: top-10 prompt quality drop (as measured by eval harness)
- Any critical customer-reported degradations on top-tier accounts (>= P1)
Action on trigger: run scripts/rollback/revert-route-v2.sh -> flip feature flag back and scale down variant nodes. Notify #release-jul-09 and start postmortem timer.

Canary window detailed notes (for ops):
- Canary 1 (04:00-04:30 UTC): 5% traffic, watch for anomalies. Leads: Marcus (exec), Evelyn (telemetry).
- Canary 2 (04:40-05:25 UTC): 25% traffic, begin warm-cold cache checks. Leads: Aisha (cutover), ML infra on standby.
- Canary 3 (05:30-06:30 UTC): 50->75% ramp; if any degradation, hold and consult on rollback.

Telemetry & smoke suite (commands & quick checks):
- Run: ./tools/smoke-runner -c telemetry/configs/prod-smoke.json --samples 200
- Quick queries:
  - errors: SUM(errors) by minute from last 15m (dashboard query id: ERR-447)
  - latency: histogram(p95) from api.*.inference for last 10m
  - cache hit: KV_CACHE_HIT_RATIO average per pod
- Expected quick checks: no new error spikes, p95 within 20% of baseline, cache hit ratio > 70%

Release notes draft (to publish after release window):
- New: Route-based canary rollout (route-v2) to allow safer model variant testing and faster rollbacks.
- Improved: Batching window tuning reduces average per-token latency by ~12% on high-concurrency workloads.
- Fixed: Edge case causing occasional 500s on long-sequence inference when KV cache miss pattern aligned with prefix requests. (JIRA-4567)
- Known issues: Small fraction of requests may see slightly different tokenization on openmodel-alpha-2026 vs base-alpha; accuracy eval shows <0.3% deviation.

Post-cutover checklist (first 6h):
- [ ] Confirm all routes reporting healthy from telemetry (owner: Evelyn)
- [ ] Validate billing counters for dedicated customers unaffected (owner: Finance touchpoint)
- [ ] Collect sample outputs for evaluation set and run quick regression check (owner: ML team)
- [ ] Document any partial rollbacks and escalate incidents (owner: Aisha)
- [ ] Add notes to release ticket and update Confluence page (owner: Marcus)

Postmortem / short-retro template (use this if rollback or incident):
- Timeline: when, what, who acted
- Root cause hypothesis + evidence (log pointers)
- Short-term mitigation taken
- Long-term fix proposals + owner + ETA
- Communication timeline (customers notified? when?)

Quick references / tools:
- Runbook: confluence link REFERENCE-OPS-RUNBOOK (long form)
- Rollback script: github.com/redwood/release-scripts/scripts/revert-route-v2.sh
- Smoke runner: tools/smoke-runner
- Slack channel: #release-jul-09
- PagerDuty: pd-release (rotation provider)

Open questions / notes-to-self (incomplete):
- Do we want an automatic rollback on model-eval-regression > 1%? Pros/cons: avoid noisy rollbacks vs user impact. Discuss in post-cutover retro.
- Can we pre-warm critical KV caches one hour before cutover to reduce early spike? Try in staging next dry-run.
- Validate cost telemetry for quantization path (Optimize team to confirm).

End logbook snippet (first-hand notes during rollout):
- 2026-07-09 04:05 UTC: flipped to canary-5. initial latency +0ms — looks stable.
- 2026-07-09 04:22 UTC: tiny error blip (0.2%) came from upstream auth timeout, not model. cleared after retry.
- TODO: capture sample payloads for that blip under /tmp/release-blips-20260709.tar.gz

--
Compact doc — keep this page on a single tab during release. Move final notes to confluence and mark this doc status=final after postmortem.
